e2ee.conflict.title: Sync conflict — {path}
e2ee.conflict.body: This note was also changed on another device. Choose what to keep; it is not synced until you decide.
e2ee.setup.title: Encrypted sync
e2ee.setup.note: Notes are encrypted on this device before upload; the sync service sees only ciphertext. A lost passphrase cannot be recovered.
e2ee.fresh.unverified: Freshness not verified: this device cannot yet tell whether the sync service shows your newest notes. Pair it with a device you already use, or confirm after checking.
e2ee.fresh.badCode: This pairing code is not valid for this vault, or it has expired.
e2ee.fresh.olderKeys: The other device is at a newer key epoch than this one sees: the sync service may be showing this device old keys. Sync both devices and try again; if it stays like this, don't trust this service.
e2ee.sync.title: Sync
e2ee.sync.provider: Where to keep the encrypted vault
e2ee.sync.kind.s3: S3-compatible storage (AWS, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, MinIO)
e2ee.sync.oauthMissing: Not available in this build: it needs Lumen's {name} app id, which is not configured.
e2ee.sync.pathStyle: Path-style addresses (MinIO and most self-hosted servers)
e2ee.sync.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the saved one
e2ee.sync.cors: Lumen could not reach {host}. The server must allow this site (CORS, and expose the ETag header); a self-hosted Lumen must also list it in VITE_CSP_CONNECT_EXTRA.
e2ee.sync.unsupported: This server cannot do safe concurrent writes, so Lumen will not sync with it: {detail}
e2ee.sync.newVault: There is no vault there yet. Choose a passphrase to create it.
e2ee.sync.existingVault: A vault is already there. Enter its passphrase.
e2ee.sync.disconnectNote: Forgets the provider on this device. Nothing at the provider is deleted.
e2ee.sync.pairCodeNote: Enter it on the other device within 2 minutes. It proves to that device which state is current; this device changes no keys meanwhile. Pairing from the new device's request (two-way) is safer.
e2ee.sync.migrate.title: Readable notes from an earlier Lumen
e2ee.sync.migrate.found: {n} unencrypted notes are in your {name} folder. Import them into the encrypted vault; the readable copies are moved into a backup folder at {name}, not deleted.
e2ee.sync.migrate.clashes: {n} of them differ from notes here; both versions are kept.
e2ee.sync.migrate.done: Imported {n} notes. The readable copies are in “{folder}” at {name}; delete that folder yourself when you are satisfied.
e2ee.sync.migrate.revert: Undo: move the readable copies back
e2ee.fresh.held: Until then, changes made on this device stay on it and are not uploaded: it can't tell yet whether it has the vault's latest keys, and a device removed meanwhile could read what it uploads.
e2ee.fresh.requestHint: Enter this request on a device you already use. It checks it against the vault as it is now and shows an answer: enter that answer above.
e2ee.pair.answerTitle: Pairing request from a new device
e2ee.pair.stale: The new device is being shown older keys than this one has: the sync service may be showing it an old state. Don't pair it; sync it and try again, and if it stays like this, don't trust this service.
e2ee.pair.pending: A pairing code from this device is still valid, so it makes no key change for now: a device paired with that code wouldn't learn of the change. Try again in a couple of minutes.
e2ee.rekey.unconfirmed: The revocation may not have taken effect: right after this key change was written, the sync service returned another device's instead (it ignored a conditional write). Sync this device: it revokes again, or says why it can't. If this happens again, don't use this service for key changes.
e2ee.fork.reapplied: The sync service replaced this device's key change with another device's. The revocation may not have taken effect for what was written in between; this device has made it again. Sync every device, and don't use this service for key changes.
e2ee.wrap.tampered: This device's key in the vault's keyring doesn't open it: the sync service changed it or put back an old one. Nothing on this device was changed. Try again later; if it stays like this, pair this device again from one you trust.
e2ee.fork.refused: The sync service returned keys that don't follow from the ones this device verified, so this device stopped (nothing on it was changed). Don't change keys or add devices until every device agrees; pair this device again from one you trust.
e2ee.fork.atRisk: The sync service returned keys that don't follow from the ones this device verified, and they may let back in a device you removed here. This device stopped; nothing on it was changed. Once every device agrees, remove that device again from a device you trust, and don't use this service for key changes.
e2ee.dropped: A device that couldn't verify the vault's device list changed the keys, and this device wasn't carried over. It wasn't removed, and nothing on it was changed: pair it again from a device you trust, or unlock it with the passphrase.
e2ee.revoked: This device was removed from the vault, so it can't open the current keys. The notes already on it stay.
e2ee.rekey.dropConfirm: This device can't verify it has the vault's latest keys, so a key change from it would leave out {devices}: they would have to be paired again. Pair this device from one you trust first, or confirm to leave them out.
e2ee.rekey.busy: Another device is changing the vault's keys right now. Sync, and try again once it has finished (10 minutes at most).
